verdicts.reason: A: the white panel fills almost the whole strip, so the pop-art shapes shrink to slivers at the edges. The FIZZBANG! logo is jammed against the left canvas edge and spills onto a pink/blue fragment, and the CTA sits flush against the right edge with no margin. B keeps a recognisable pop-art block on the left (pink circle, dark quarter-circle, yellow stripe), which preserves the brand feel, and the headline and CTA have better breathing room. But B's logo sits on top of the busy yellow stripe and blue background, straddling the edge of the panel, and the right side ends in an unbalanced empty white area.
